verdict.rationale: The official docs say Omarchy Quattro can install to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations, and the manual has a dedicated dual-boot-beside-Windows page. A community user mentions considering dual-booting it on a work laptop, but no one reports actually doing it. Missing for 10: detailed dual-boot procedure in the evidence (bootloader handling, partitioning steps, Secure Boot/encryption interplay), hands-on corroboration of a successful dual-boot install.
